name: M15 fast-slow SMA cross continuation and fade batch

source_references.citation: Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron (1992), Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns, Journal of Finance 47, 1731-1764
source_references.supports: Opened publisher abstract tests moving-average rules on the Dow Jones Index from 1897-1986, not this M15 FX rule, costs or profitability.

research.evidence_summary: Historical equity-index moving-average evidence is a narrow measurement boundary. The M15 FX crossover, response mappings and holds are an original falsification with no profitability claim.

feasibility.rationale: Causal M15 closes, prior ATR, signal-close fills and day-flat exits are supported inputs; implementation transport needs V2 confirmation.

market.base_timeframe: M1 aggregated to completed London M15 bars
market.session: Weekday signals ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; exit by 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated causally to M15
data.minimum_history: Seventeen consecutive valid M15 closes ending at signal t plus ATR96 through t-1
preprocessing: Every M15 bar in the 17-close union requires exactly fifteen physically consecutive valid M1 candles
OHLC must be finite/positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close)

Build true ranges only from valid observed M15 bars without forward fill. ATR96 through t-1 is Wilder ATR on that observed sequence; after an earlier elapsed gap, the next valid bar uses the latest valid observed close as previous-close reference. The 17-close signal union remains physically consecutive.
Use IANA Europe/London and canonical UTC
limitations: Long-horizon equity evidence is not intraday FX evidence

hypothesis.behavior: A first SMA4/SMA16 M15 cross may briefly continue with or fade against its direction over 30-60 minutes.
hypothesis.mechanism: A cross may summarize temporary gradual repricing, while the inverse tests lagged reversal.
works_when: A cross marks a real temporary state change beyond costs
fails_when: The crossover is delayed noise or costs dominate
falsifiable_predictions: Both holds for one mode are positive normal/doubled
Center is positive in both UTC halves and three symbols

definitions.name: cross_direction
definitions.formula: +1 iff SMA4_prior<=SMA16_prior and SMA4_current>SMA16_current; -1 iff prior >= and current <; otherwise 0
definitions.timing: Strict current crossing after t close

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: cross_direction for FOLLOW_CROSS and negative cross_direction for FADE_CROSS

entries.long_condition: eligible cross and trade_side=+1 and cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible cross and trade_side=-1 and cell flat
entries.signal_time: Completed London M15 boundary 09:00-13:45 where hold ends by 15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at V2 supported executable signal-close fill; unavailable fill suppresses and reports event. Stop eligibility starts next M1.
restrictions: Prior equality qualifies; current equality is no event
A qualifying cross while its symbol/cell is non-flat is skipped, not queued or deferred; a later trade requires a newly qualifying cross

exits.stop_loss: Let B_t be signal-close bid and A_t ATR96_prior. S_long=B_t-A_t and S_short=B_t+A_t. Long triggers on bid at/below S_long; short triggers on executable ask at/above S_short. Gaps fill at worse executable next open. Chart-stop distance defines sizing, not a realized-loss guarantee.
exits.time_exit: Exit at executable M1 close exactly due; STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT; unavailable post-entry M1 or due fill invalidates complete affected cell without substituted P&L.
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 London
exits.end_of_session: Only admit entries maturing by 15:00; defect is simulation-fatal to affected cell

risk.position_sizing: For long d=entry_ask-S_long; for short d=S_short-entry_bid. Require finite d>0. Size q so q*d is 0.25% of common pre-entry cell equity, excluding commission/slippage; spread is embedded in executable entry versus chart stop. Skip invalid/unrepresentable size. Gaps, commission and slippage can exceed 0.25%.
risk.maximum_risk_per_trade: 0.25% current equity at executable entry-to-chart-stop distance before commission/slippage; realized loss can exceed it
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial risk per cell
risk.leverage: Use lower of risk size and V2 limit
risk.concurrent_positions: One per symbol; four cells have independent state

experiment.baseline: SMA4/SMA16 first cross; FOLLOW_CROSS; hold=60; one-ATR chart stop
robustness_tests: Report four cells and frozen pre-R024 ledger snapshot reports/STRATEGY_THROUGHPUT_LEDGER.md updated 2026-11-05T21:43:00Z SHA-256 c52bff77b31b9b519af2107af3a15d2af1452396cfd1663f9af30ab5cc0ae63c plus four cells

Let m be the exact UTC midpoint timestamp of fixed V2 development interval; boundary close at m belongs to first half. Center hold=60 must have positive net R in both halves and at least three symbols with positive net R in each half

For each mode, rank normal-cost hold=60 aggregate six-symbol net R by London date descending, ties ISO date ascending; remove same top five dates from both holds, or reject if fewer than five eligible dates

For each cell bootstrap total net R from its zero-filled eligible London-weekday daily net-R series: 10000 circular five-date blocks, original series length, seed 2026024; both 2.5th percentile bounds must exceed zero

Define R010/R014/R017 overlap as same symbol and same completed M15 boundary; report normal/doubled intersection and complement R. Complement below 100 trades rejects promotion; every informative complement must be positive under both costs
experiment.multiple_testing: Frozen pre-R024 inventory is reports/STRATEGY_THROUGHPUT_LEDGER.md snapshot 2026-11-05T21:43:00Z SHA-256 c52bff77b31b9b519af2107af3a15d2af1452396cfd1663f9af30ab5cc0ae63c: 17 families/352 selectable cells. This fixed four-cell batch makes 18 families/356 cells. Diagnostics, sources, robustness and overlaps are non-selectable context; no best-cell rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds positive normal/doubled
Reject center non-positive in either UTC half or fewer than three symbols per half
Reject unless after date removal both holds retain positive normal- and doubled-cost net R and their bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero; reject any non-positive informative overlap complement

pseudocode: Trigger strict first cross; map follow/fade; enter flat cell
Stop before time exit from next M1; invalidate defect cell
edge_cases: prior equality qualifies/current equality does not
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal M1 pass per symbol.
known_backtester_gaps: V2 confirmation needed for feature, fill, invalidation and result rows
